subject: Multi-region residency MAP: EU cross-border review & evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Emma Brun <emma.brun@euratek.com>, Pierre Leduc <pierre.leduc@eurobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: MAP: Multi-region residency alignment (EU) & evaluation plan

Hi Emma / Pierre —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m starting the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) thread to align stakeholders, decision milestones, and the evaluation plan for the EU deployment and cross-border data review. I’ve attached a proposed MAP spreadsheet (MAP_proposal_v0.1.xlsx) and a quick CSV summary of the residency scope.

Objectives for this thread:
- Confirm which EU countries and data categories are in-scope for residency controls
- Align on legal and security review owners and their deliverables
- Agree on evaluation criteria (latency, throughput, encryption-at-rest, audit log fidelity)
- Finalize a decision calendar to hit contract close in Q1 (target: 2027-01-19)

Proposed high-level timeline (suggested):
1) Week 0 (this week): stakeholder introductions, finalize MAP owners and gating criteria
2) Week 1: security questionnaire + evidence handoff; infra proof-of-concept for cross-border topology
3) Week 2: evaluation run (sample traffic, audit log verification), legal sign-off
4) Week 3: final MAP updates + procurement/contracting queue

Requested confirmations: please reply with the primary owner for Legal, Security, and Infrastructure on your side. I’ve tentatively assigned Laura (Redwood product lead) and Marissa (solutions lead) to coordinate on our side. Rafael (security) and Hannah (regional compliance) are on standby for technical review.

Key risks to surface early: cross-border replication for KV caches, third-party monitoring logs, and KMS/HSM key residency. If there are other showstoppers—please flag them now so we can document mitigations in the MAP.

Next step: if we can lock owners today, I’ll schedule a 60-minute alignment call for 11/30 14:00 CET.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Engineering, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_proposal_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), residency_scope_sheet.csv (csv)

From: Emma Brun <emma.brun@euratek.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Pierre Leduc <pierre.leduc@eurobank.com>, Euratek Legal <legal@euratek.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MAP: Multi-region residency alignment (EU) & evaluation plan

Thanks Jonas — this look useful.

Quick responses:
- Legal owner: I’ve looped in our legal mailbox for intake (legal@euratek.com) and assigned Pierre as commercial lead on our side.
- Security owner: I will introduce our security lead (TBD) in the next update — they want the EDF and audit log sample prior to the call.
- Scope clarification: we expect France, Germany, and Netherlands to be in scope for residency; Austria is borderline pending regulator question.

Can we push the alignment call to 14:30 CET? Pierre has another meeting until 14:15. Also — can you add a short decision calendar with exact review windows so our procurement can reserve dates?

Emma Brun
Program Manager, Cloud Governance — Euratek
emma.brun@euratek.com
+33 1 23 45 67 89

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Multi-region residency alignment (EU) & evaluation plan

Emma / Pierre — happy to adjust to 14:30 CET. Thanks for the scope note — that helps.

Two quick items from our side before the call:
1) Rafael (cc’d) will lead the security evidence intake. Rafael — I’ve uploaded our recommended evidence checklist and a short data-flow diagram to the shared drive; attaching the PDF here for quick reference (data_flow_eu.pdf).
2) Evaluation plan: we propose a short, gated evaluation with clear criteria that we will score as Pass / Pass with Issues / Fail. Criteria suggestions:
   - Residency verification: host-level attestations + geo-IP checks
   - Audit log completeness: token-level traces for 7 sample sessions
   - Latency SLO: p95 < 250ms for redlined endpoints with sampled traffic
   - Crypto: keys managed in EU KMS or customer-managed HSM (if required)

For the meeting I’ll bring a 15-minute demo of the region routing + a 15-minute runbook walkthrough for the evidence handoff. I’ll also post a pared-down decision calendar in the drive with the exact review windows (legal review: 3 business days, security evidence: 5 business days, POC run: 2 days).

Proposed attendees (please confirm or add):
- Euratek: Emma Brun (program), Pierre Leduc (commercial), Euratek Legal
- Redwood: Jonas Weber (owner), Laura Bennett (product), Marissa Cole (solutions), Rafael Mendes (security), Hannah Schmitt (compliance)

If that looks good, I’ll lock the calendar invite for 14:30 CET and drop the drive links.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: data_flow_eu.pdf (diagram)
